title: Pod Salt Nexus Strawberry Lychee Ice Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Pod Salt Nexus Strawberry Lychee Ice Nic Salt delivers a distinctive fruit blend with a refreshing edge. Sweet, juicy Strawberries provide a familiar summer note, while the Lychee adds an exotic lift with its delicate, floral sweetness. A streak of Ice completes the mix, bringing a brisk chill that enhances both fruits and leaves a clean, refreshing finish. This Nic Salt e-liquid is mixed at 50VG/50PG, making it ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with refillable vapes , starter vape kits , and vape pens . The nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid absorption with a tactile yet comfortable throat hit, while producing discreet vapour and consistent flavour. As part of the Pod Salt Nexus collection, Strawberry Lychee Ice demonstrates the brand’s skill at crafting inventive blends. Each 10ml bottle is produced in the UK to the highest standards, offering dependable quality and flavour.
